title: Locating the early Panama and Deluxe on 35th Street
summary: They sort out whether the old Panama and Deluxe were upstairs or downstairs at 35th and State; her Panama was the later one on 58th.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Well, did you know about that Panama? That was next to Deluxe, wasn't it?
It was downstairs, I think. Yeah. I think it was downstairs, but it was right there at 35th and stayed. No, it was upstairs. On the corner.
The corner, upstairs. Yeah, on the corner, upstairs. The Glover tells me that both upstairs and downstairs were used at a time.

Well, possibly so. And you remember it, though, as being upstairs. Yes, I remember upstairs. Deluxe certainly was upstairs. Deluxe was upstairs. Panama's on the corner, Deluxe next to it. Yes. See, upstairs. See, I remember that. See, so... This was the late Panama that I worked at, 55th, 58th Street, see? So, I never worked with any of those, any of those people. But they knew me, but I never worked with them, see? Was Nettie principally a ballad-type singer? No, I never saw her work in my life. I never saw her work. I've seen Glover play piano, but I never saw Nettie work, see? Because, in the first place, I don't think Nettie worked since she came back. I don't think...
